description:
Search AI-native products by free text,
membership (category, job-to-be-done, capability, publisher organization or
person, SDK language,
license, certification, access control, agent skill, benchmark,
documentation resource, MFA type), AI-native ``tier``, active-offer
``billing_model``/``payment_method``, or affordance booleans (``has_mcp``
selects hosted MCP servers; ``has_mcp_url`` narrows that to a dialable endpoint
url; ``has_api_spec`` and ``spec_type`` select API
specs). Membership and reference filters take one slug or an array (OR
within a filter; filters combine with AND). ``view="compact"`` returns a curated
shortlist projection for a first pass (identity, the rating and coverage
signals, the affordance booleans, and the connect summary) and cannot combine
with ``fields``; ``fields`` trims the payload to an explicit set and ``expand``
resolves relation ``*_ids`` into inline objects. Returns a
cursor-paginated page whose products carry ``ai_native_score`` (0-100),
``ai_native_tier`` (S/A/B/C/D), the research-coverage axis ``coverage_score``
(0-100) and derived ``unrated`` boolean, the ``attested_absences`` list, and
the read booleans ``has_mcp``, ``has_mcp_url``, ``has_sdk``, ``has_api_spec``,
``has_cli``, and ``has_a2a`` (each reports catalog record presence),
and ``free_plan`` (True when the product has an active free-tier offer; null
when none is recorded,
so rank a shortlist by cost without opening each product — the value is never
false because offers carry no attested absence). Evidence-based filters exclude
unknown values in both directions. Negative relation filters require whole-relation
absence evidence. Negative offer filters return zero matches until offer absence
is supported. Read presence booleans alone do not establish filter evidence.
The page carries ``filter_breakdown``: ``matched``, ``recorded_nonmatch``, and
``unknown`` counts for each supported filter. Previously covered positive requests
also retain ``recorded_negative`` as an alias of ``recorded_nonmatch``.
Sum only the three canonical counts. Refinements include ``spec_type``,
``sdk_language``, ``has_mcp_url``, every ``data_export`` set, and certification,
access-control, or agent-skill membership. A different relation member leaves
the requested value unknown. ``get_product`` has the full reading guidance.
The REST ``*_id``
UUID filters and the web-only ``following`` filter are intentionally not exposed
here; use the HTTP API for those.

access_control.description: Filter by access-control slug. Accepts one slug or a nonempty array of slugs; an array matches any (OR). Separate filters combine with AND.

agent_skill.description: Filter by agent-skill slug. Accepts one slug or a nonempty array of slugs; an array matches any (OR). Separate filters combine with AND.

benchmark.description: Filter by benchmark slug. Accepts one slug or a nonempty array of slugs; an array matches any (OR). Separate filters combine with AND.

billing_model.description: Filter by an active offer's billing-model slug. Accepts one slug or a nonempty array of slugs; an array matches any (OR). Separate filters combine with AND.

capability.description: Deprecated alias for capability_slug. Supply only one spelling.

capability_slug.description: Filter by capability slug. Accepts one slug or a nonempty array of slugs; an array matches any (OR). Separate filters combine with AND.

category.description: Filter by category slug. Accepts one slug or a nonempty array of slugs; an array matches any (OR). Separate filters combine with AND.

certification.description: Filter by compliance certification slug, e.g. soc-2. List tool: list_compliance_certifications. Accepts one slug or a nonempty array of slugs; an array matches any (OR). Separate filters combine with AND.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from a previous page's response.

data_export.description: Recorded data export support: full, partial, or none. Supply an array for OR matching. Unknown values are excluded.

documentation_resource.description: Filter by documentation-resource slug. Accepts one slug or a nonempty array of slugs; an array matches any (OR). Separate filters combine with AND.

expand.description: Comma-separated product relations to expand inline as full objects rather than opaque *_ids, following the REST ?expand= grammar. Example: mcp_servers,developer_kits,capabilities. Lets you resolve a result's affordance IDs (SDK languages, spec URLs, MCP endpoints) without a follow-up get_product call. An invalid value returns the allowed set. Omit it for the lighter id-only page.

fields.description: Comma-separated top-level response fields to include, following the REST ?fields= grammar. The response always keeps id. Narrows the payload for compact reads; an expanded relation is still returned only when its field is in the selection. Omit for the full record.

free_plan.description: True matches products with an active Offer containing a structured pricing option with price_kind: free. False returns zero matches until the catalog supports offer absence. Missing offers remain unknown. Omit to leave unfiltered. Prose-only free allowances do not match without a qualifying structured option. Offers can have quotas, eligibility restrictions, noncommercial terms, or attribution requirements. Inspect offer terms and url. Example: search_products(free_plan=true, expand="offers"). Accepts true/false, 1/0, yes/no, or on/off, ignoring case and surrounding whitespace. Empty values are invalid.

has_a2a.description: Accepts true/false, 1/0 (JSON boolean or number), yes/no, or on/off, ignoring case and surrounding whitespace. Empty values are invalid. Omit to leave unfiltered.

has_api_spec.description: Accepts true/false, 1/0 (JSON boolean or number), yes/no, or on/off, ignoring case and surrounding whitespace. Empty values are invalid. Omit to leave unfiltered.

job_to_be_done.description: Filter by job-to-be-done slug. Accepts one slug or a nonempty array of slugs; an array matches any (OR). Separate filters combine with AND.

query.description: Deprecated alias for search; renames to the same catalog parameter. Use search instead (ADR-0033).

sandbox.description: Accepts true/false, 1/0 (JSON boolean or number), yes/no, or on/off, ignoring case and surrounding whitespace. Empty values are invalid. Omit to leave unfiltered.

sdk_language.description: Filter by a product SDK's programming-language slug, e.g. python. Accepts one slug or a nonempty array of slugs; an array matches any (OR). Separate filters combine with AND.

search.description: Free-text search across products. Search matches product name, description, and related capability and job-to-be-done names by meaning, so query the capability a product provides, such as "weather forecast", not the user's whole goal, such as "plan a family outing based on weather". When set, the response carries a page-level `strong_match` boolean: `false` means every returned product surfaced only through approximate meaning-similarity, or there were none, so narrow the search before relying on a result. On a `false` match the response also lists `suggested_categories` and `suggested_jobs_to_be_done` (lexical matches most-populated first, semantic matches nearest-intent first; each with a `product_count` and a `match_kind`) — pass a suggestion's slug to the matching filter to switch from free-text search to exact membership. `match_kind` is `lexical` when the term's label contained your wording and `semantic` when it is a close match on intent worth checking. An empty suggestion list means neither your wording nor its intent matched a term; retry with a shorter query or browse the taxonomy.

self_hostable.description: Matches the recorded boolean; excludes unknown. Accepts true/false, 1/0, yes/no, or on/off, ignoring case and whitespace. Omit to leave unfiltered.

spec_type.description: API specification type: openapi, grpc, or graphql. Supply an array for OR matching. Invalid values return the allowed set.

tier.description: AI-native tier: S, A, B, C, D, or Unrated. A letter matches only products whose coverage clears the research threshold; Unrated matches the rest. Accepts one slug or a nonempty array of slugs; an array matches any (OR). Separate filters combine with AND.

view.description: Opt-in named projection, mirroring the REST `view` parameter. `compact` returns the shortlist field set for a first pass: product identity, the ai_native_tier, ai_native_score, coverage_score, and unrated rating signals, the has_* affordance booleans, and the connect summary. It omits the *_ids arrays and the null-heavy decision scalars. Pagination, the weak-match signal, and the suggested categories and jobs are unchanged. Cannot combine with fields. Omit for the full record.

web_mcp.description: Accepts true/false, 1/0 (JSON boolean or number), yes/no, or on/off, ignoring case and surrounding whitespace. Empty values are invalid. Omit to leave unfiltered.

zero_data_retention.description: Accepts true/false, 1/0 (JSON boolean or number), yes/no, or on/off, ignoring case and surrounding whitespace. Empty values are invalid. Omit to leave unfiltered.
